ai_operations_rejected_has_no_hold_or_pr.name: ai_operations_rejected_has_no_hold_or_provider
ai_operations_rejected_has_no_hold_or_pr.value: "status" <> 'rejected' OR ("hold_micro" IS NULL AND "provider" IS NULL)

credit_movements_purchase_sign.name: credit_movements_purchase_sign
credit_movements_purchase_sign.value: "type" <> 'purchase' OR ("amount_micro" > 0 AND "bucket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

credit_movements_adjustment_admin.name: credit_movements_adjustment_admin
credit_movements_adjustment_admin.value: "type" <> 'adjustment' OR ("bucket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_id" IS NOT NULL)

credit_movements_refund_sign.name: credit_movements_refund_sign
credit_movements_refund_sign.value: "type" <> 'refund' OR ("amount_micro" < 0 AND "bucket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_reason" IS NOT NULL)

credit_movements_settlement_shape.name: credit_movements_settlement_shape
credit_movements_settlement_shape.value: "type" <> 'debt_settlement' OR ("payment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "admin_id" IS NOT NULL)

fx_rates_ecb_fields.name: fx_rates_ecb_fields
fx_rates_ecb_fields.value: "source" = 'manual' OR ("ecb_rate_ppm" > 0 AND "ecb_date" IS NOT NULL AND "buffer_ppm" IS NOT NULL)
